universe_screen.query: Market Capitalization > 12000 AND Price to earning < Industry PE AND Price to earning > 0 AND Return on equity > 12 AND Debt to equity < 1 AND Pledged percentage < 20 AND Current price > DMA 50 AND DMA 50 > DMA 200 AND Current price > High price * 0.75
universe_screen.source: Rebuilt: Nifty 500 constituents (niftyindices CSV) -> Yahoo 1y daily (technicals, computed) -> screener.in company pages (fundamentals; PE/mcap/PB rescaled to the 16-Oct NSE close where the page showed another price) -> screener.in industry pages (industry PE) -> NSE SHP XBRL (pledge)

technical_rules.A: close > SMA50 > SMA200 and close > 0.75 x 52wH (literal query)
technical_rules.B: close > SMA50, SMA50 <= SMA200 but SMA200 rising over 20 sessions, close > 0.75 x 52wH (secondary, flagged)

universe_screen.industry_pe_basis: Primary: median positive P/E of top-25-by-mcap peers on screener industry page 1. Secondary flag: median across all pages.

track_b_5k.value_test: 5k<=mcap<=12k & PE>0 & PE<IndPE(top25) & ROE>12 & D/E<1 (non-fin) & pledge<20 & ADV20>=25Cr

setup_c_candidates.definition: Nifty 500 / Microcap 250 names with a Q2 FY27 results board meeting 1-18 Oct 2026 (NSE board-meeting API, past dates). Results timestamp from NSE corporate-announcements. Reaction session = results day if filed before 15:30 IST, else next session. Post-result move = reaction-session open vs prior close (after-market filings) or reaction-day close vs prior close (intraday filings). Held = every close since the reaction session >= the pre-result close. Eligible = move > 0, held, >= 3 sessions, mcap >= 5,000 Cr, ADV >= 25 Cr.
